strategy.name: Volume Profile & Auction Market Theory
strategy.summary: Use the previous day's value area, POC, and low-volume nodes; the '80% rule' targets the other side of value.

rules.text: 80% rule: open outside the previous value area, then two 30m closes back inside → trade to the opposite boundary.
rules.checklistQuestion: Were there two 30m closes back inside value?

rules.text: TP1 = POC; TP2 = the opposite value-area boundary.
rules.checklistQuestion: Were targets at the POC and the opposite boundary?

rules.text: Stop beyond the swing outside the value area.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop beyond the outside swing?

rules.text: If two 30m candles hold outside VAH with rising volume, do not fade; trade continuation on a VAH retest.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you avoid fading an accepted breakout?
